text:
deploy-bot: Rollout started for release `v3.4.0` to prod (all regions). Monitoring p95 latency, error-rate, kvcache miss rate. Auto-rollback=enabled. Watchers: 12.

ash: seeing p95 latency +22% in eu-west-1, errors up ~1.8% vs baseline. small spike on a subset of nodes.

maria: confirmed — telemetry shows KV cache miss spike + CPU jitter and a few OOMs on older GPU hosts. US looks nominal.

sajid: deploy-bot auto-rollback triggered for eu-west-1 at 1739991254: reason=kvcache-regression, threshold=1.5% error lift. It started a rollback to `v3.3.8`. Is that expected? @jen

jen: I did not kick a manual rollback. We deliberately planned to do manual pin if regression >2%. Looks like the rule fired earlier. @ops-oncall can you take a read and hold if needed?

ops-oncall: Auto-rollback initiated by rule `rollback-on-kvcache-lift`. I can pause the automation and set a manual lock. Recommend promoting `v3.3.9` (has kv hotfix) and pin EU to that if we want minimal disruption. Need green from eng.

oliver: quick reality check — we don't currently have `v3.3.9` in the EU reserved pool; promoting will take ~5-10m. Option A: let rollback to 3.3.8 continue (already started). Option B: push 3.3.9 and do a small canary then pin. Which do we want?

ash: customer impact low but prefer promote 3.3.9 and then pin. limits blast radius and restores latency. I can push the patch. ETA 8-10m.

jen: +1 from me. ops-oncall please hold further auto-rollback actions and set manual lock for eu-west-1. I'll handle comms and release-note updates.

ops-oncall: Holding auto-rollback for eu-west-1 now. Lock created. Command run:
```
redwoodctl rollout lock --region eu-west-1 --reason "manual hold after auto-rollback" --by jen
```

deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Auto-rollback suppressed in eu-west-1 for 30m. Will still escalate if errors >5% or infra critical alerts hit.

ash: patch promoted to artifact registry and starting controlled 10% rollout to eu-west-1:
```
redwoodctl promote --artifact v3.3.9 --region eu-west-1 --traffic 10
```

maria: monitoring after promotion: p95 down from +22% to +3% within the first 5m. no new OOMs observed. :thumbsup:

jen: drafting status update for customers: "We observed a small regional degradation in EU that affected latency. We rolled back the affected fleet and promoted a patch; traffic is stable. No broad impact. Dedicated customers, please contact your SE if you saw anomalies." Will post to status page and ping sales.

oliver: opening ticket to sync changelog and release notes, attaching diff and timeline. tagging @sajid for postmortem.

sajid: thanks — I'll own the postmortem and add the rollback rule tuning to the action items (lower sensitivity for transient kvcache blips).

deploy-bot: Thread ended after manual pin + patch promotion. If further regressions occur, auto-rollback remains suppressed and escalation will go to @ops-oncall."
